Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 47: the slip of [[Spaceport: Docking Bay (V) (Errata)|◊Spaceport: Docking Bay (Dark) (V)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E1, with “Your pilots deploy +1 here.” added to the Light Side text.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
